cc:Work.dc:title: communication-study-modulation-noise
cc:Work.dc:description: Synchronized DSB receiver with real AWGN PSD N0/2, bilateral RF bands centered at plus/minus fc and positive-frequency RF width 2W, mixer 2 cos and unit-gain LPF [-W,W]. Time-averaged output PSD N0 over [-W,W]; input/output noise powers both 2N0W and useful output signal power 2PR. No blanket SNR factor is asserted outside these conditions.
